name: CombinedKinematicEngine
description: Engine for applying combined displacements on pre-defined bodies. Constructed using ``+`` operator on regular KinematicEngines<KinematicEngine>. The ``ids`` operated on are those of the first engine in the combination (assigned automatically).

attributes.name: comb
attributes.description: Kinematic engines that will be combined by this one, run in the order given.
